dhk_kafetzis.text: A kafeneio is a coffee house, but really it's a living room for the whole village. Men come to talk, argue, play cards and not go home.
I serve Cypriot coffee, Cypriot brandy sours, and the best loukoumi in the district, the little rose-scented squares that taste like a flower.

dhk_tavli.text: Tavli is backgammon with more shouting. You throw the dice, you slap the pieces down, and you tell your opponent exactly what you think of his mother.
It's all done with affection. We've been playing the same game since 1971.
